name: window_template
description: Two workers cover four days, exactly one per day, and nobody works two days in a row; working day d and day d+2 earns a bonus of 1. The day set is linear: no_consecutive is left out for the last day and the bonus terms for the last two days (TEMPLATE_BOUNDARY_SKIPPED). Optimum 12: w1 on d1 and d3, w2 on d2 and d4.
